limits: Authentication snapshot, headers and rate limiter are simulated; hashing, POST, service, transactions and database effects are real.
Five authority changes are injected immediately after actual bcrypt hashing, before the transaction; this is a controlled interleaving, not a real browser race.
MFA proof time is a fixture. PostgreSQL pg_stat_activity confirms waiting for a row lock before it is released after expiration.
Before correction the request could wait later on the actor foreign-key check during audit insertion; after correction the authority guard waits before the first write.
An intermediate test fixture omitted required MFA session fields; this fixture error was fixed before the final successful 110-test run.
These explicit SQL runs are separate from the root standard suite, where database tests without dedicated variables are skipped.
